data.body_html:
Ring in 2043 from the best seat in Marbella: your own private boat on the Mediterranean. A Marbella boat rental for NYE 2043 gives you front-row access to the city's fireworks display, with zero crowds, unlimited drinks, and a licensed skipper handling everything. Our fleet of 12 vessels departs from Puerto Banús, with prices starting at €749 for 2 hours. Here's how to book and what to expect.

Why Watch NYE Fireworks from a Boat?

Marbella's coastline transforms into a glittering stage on New Year's Eve. From the water, you see the entire skyline—from La Concha mountain to the Golden Mile—reflected in the sea. No jostling for space on the promenade, no queues for champagne. Just you, your guests, and a panoramic view of the fireworks bursting over Marbella Marina and Puerto Banús. The sea is calm in winter, and your skipper will anchor at the perfect spot.

Our NYE Fleet: Which Boat Fits Your Party?

We have 12 boats tailor-made for NYE celebrations. For intimate groups of up to 5, the Dubhe (8m) or Mariah SX21 (6.4m) are cosy options. For larger parties, the Mangusta 80 (24m, 12 pax) or Ferretti 94 (29m, 12 pax) offer luxury and space. All boats include a skipper, fuel, drinks, and snacks—so you can focus on the countdown. See our full fleet list for dimensions and capacities.

Pricing: What Does a NYE Charter Cost?

We keep pricing transparent. Tier A boats (Astondoa 40, Azimut 39) cost €749 for 2 hours or €2,299 for 8 hours, including all drinks and VAT. Tier B boats (Mangusta 80 and Mangusta 80 Grey) start at €4,719 for a minimum 4-hour charter, with a free jet ski included. For all other vessels, pricing is on request via WhatsApp—just tell us your group size and preferred duration.

What's Included in Every Charter

Every NYE booking comes with: a licensed skipper, fuel, water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, light snacks, insurance, safety equipment, and Spanish IVA (21%). No hidden extras. You can also bring your own food or decorations. Just let us know in advance so the crew can prepare the boat accordingly.

Best Fireworks Viewing Spots from the Sea

Your skipper knows the best anchor points for fireworks viewing. Typically, boats position off the coast of Marbella Marina or near the Golden Mile, where the main display is visible. Some charters also cruise towards Puerto Banús for a second show. You'll have an unobstructed 180-degree view of the skyline, with the city lights reflecting on the water. The crew will keep the drinks flowing as the clock strikes midnight.

How to Book Your NYE 2043 Boat

Booking is simple: contact us via WhatsApp with your preferred boat, number of guests, and desired time. We recommend booking at least 2–3 months in advance—NYE slots are the first to sell out. Once confirmed, you'll receive a booking confirmation and meeting point details at Puerto Banús. For questions about availability or custom requests, just drop us a message.

Frequently Asked Questions

Which boats are available for NYE 2043 in Marbella?

We offer 12 boats departing Puerto Banús, including the Astondoa 40 (12.5m, 9 pax), Azimut 39 (12.5m, 11 pax), Mangusta 80 (24m, 12 pax), and others. Sizes range from 6.4m to 29m, accommodating 5 to 12 guests. See our full fleet list for details.

What is the price for a boat rental on NYE 2043?

Tier A boats (Astondoa 40, Azimut 39) cost €749 for 2 hours or €2,299 for 8 hours, including skipper, drinks, and VAT. Tier B boats (Mangusta 80) start at €4,719 for 4 hours with a free jet ski. Other boats are priced on request via WhatsApp.

What is included in the charter price?

Every charter includes a licensed skipper, fuel, water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, light snacks, insurance, safety equipment, and Spanish IVA (21%). No hidden fees.

Where do the boats depart from?

All boats depart from Puerto Banús, Marbella. You'll meet the crew at the marina, then head out to the best fireworks viewing spots along the coast.

Can I see the Marbella fireworks from the boat?

Yes. The best views of Marbella's NYE fireworks are from the sea. Your skipper will position the boat for an unobstructed view of the skyline, typically near the Golden Mile or off the coast of Marbella Marina.

How do I book a boat for NYE 2043?

Contact us via WhatsApp for real-time availability and to secure your booking. Provide your preferred boat, number of guests, and desired time slot. We recommend booking early as NYE slots fill quickly.

What if the weather is bad on NYE?

Your safety is paramount. If the skipper deems conditions unsafe, the charter will be rescheduled or refunded. We monitor forecasts closely and communicate any changes.

Can I bring my own food or decorations?

Yes, you are welcome to bring your own food and decorations. The boat comes with a cooler and basic amenities. Just let us know in advance to ensure space.
